Since 1969

The Sannine Legacy:
Five Decades of Fire & Craft

In 1969, nestled beneath the majestic snow-crested peaks of Mount Sannine, our founder ignited Beirut’s first artisanal slow-turning copper drum roaster. With an unyielding reverence for Levantine hospitality, he sought to unite the ancient tradition of Turkish cardamom coffee with the refined precision of European espresso crafting.

Unlike mass-commercial flash roasters that scorch delicate beans in minutes, Sannine adheres strictly to calibrated low-temperature convective drum roasting. This gentle caramelization protects the volatile aromatic monoterpenes and oils, delivering an unmistakable velvet sweetness and resonant finish in every cup.

1969
The First Copper Drum

Founded on Rue Allenby, Beirut, roasting Ethiopian wild coffees and royal green cardamom.

1985
Specialty Nut Roastery

Expanded into hand-roasted Aleppo pistachios and saffron-glazed cashews in open copper basins.

2006
Direct Trade Micro-Lots

Established direct partnerships with award-winning high-elevation estates in Yirgacheffe and Huila.

2026
Global Flagship Era

Serving connoisseurs worldwide across Beirut, Dubai DIFC, London Mayfair, and through our curated club.

“True roasting is not merely applying heat to a seed; it is awakening the hidden soul of the mountain and the earth.”

— Master Roaster Abou Salim • Beirut, 1969
